tonight.headline: Week 6 is won — 122.6 to 82.94, and neither side has a starter left
body: Bad news first: Tyler Allgeier's 5.8 in the flex lost the start/sit call to Kamara (14.9 on the bench) by 9.1, and Josh Allen finished 7.2 under his projection. Jordan Love's 20.2 also sat on the bench, behind Allen.

None of it cost the week. Bok-aneers finished at 82.94 once Kraft and Lloyd were done; every AVIATO starter was final at 122.6. ESPN has it at 100%, and it goes in the book as 2-4 when Monday night closes the week. Nothing to do today; the next move is Love for Allen when Week 7 opens.

case.label: Why nothing
case.body: Every starter on both sides has played. McLaurin plays Monday night at San Francisco from your bench and cannot change the result either way.

case.label: The real cost of the week
case.body: Allgeier's 5.8 against Kamara's 14.9 is the only lineup call that lost (closed WRONG last night). Love's 20.2 does not count against the lineup: Allen at 25.5 projected was the right start and is not graded on one week.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A stat correction of more than 39.6 points — nothing realistic.

doFirst.title: Start Jordan Love for Josh Allen in Week 7

case.label: The bye
case.body: Buffalo's bye is Week 7 (ESPN file), and so are Jacksonville's (Tuten), Washington's (McLaurin) and the Chargers'. Love's Green Bay bye is Week 11. Love was added on 15 Oct for exactly this week.

case.label: Checked this morning
case.body: Love finished 20.2 in a 23-13 win over Dallas — 23 of 41 for 276 and a rushing touchdown — and Packers.com's in-game log lists no Love injury (Packers.com 18 Oct). Allen finished healthy (Yahoo 18 Oct, carried; Buffalo enter their bye at 5-1).

case.label: The rest of Week 7
case.body: Jefferson and Gordon return from byes. Tuten's running-back slot goes to whoever Tuesday's Week 7 projection prefers among Allgeier, Kamara and Gordon. Bam Knight's 'possible injury' was full-body cramps (azcardinals.com 18 Oct), so Arizona's backfield is a live split while Love is out — a real question, not a formality.

case.label: Not an override
case.body: A bye is a zero. This is a forced move, not a read of Love against Allen.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Love is hurt tonight or ruled out for Week 7 (then a free-agent quarterback, not Love), or Week 7 projections put a free quarterback more than two points above him and the swap is made anyway.
